rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a thin, sharp fragment that has broken or been cut off.

example.english: Be careful; there’s a sliver of wood by the edge of the board, and stepping on it would hurt.
example.traditional: 小心啲，木板邊有塊碎片，拮親隻腳就麻煩喇。
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 muk6 baan2 bin1 jau5 faai3 seoi3 pin2 git3 can1 zek3 goek3 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a very small amount of something, especially when stressing how tiny it is.

example.english: This soup is so bland it doesn’t have even a sliver of flavor.
example.traditional: 呢杯湯淡到連一丁點味道都冇。
example.jyutping: ne1 bui1 tong1 taam5 dou3 lin4 jat1 ding1 dim2 mei6 dou6 dou1 mou5
